change.title: Extract the mutating cold one-click coordinator
change.summary: Separates immutable entry decision and healthy reopen dispatch from the mutating cold/recovery transaction while preserving the existing prior-stop, SSH, authority, Gateway, Science, journal, finalize, DTO, and compensation contracts.

basis: one_click_login_with_options retains config/auth validation, immutable entry facts, pure branch decision, healthy reopen, exact cleanup recapture, and one cold dispatch
run_cold_one_click exclusively owns mutating SSH prevalidation, prior-stop publication, AuthorityTransaction, Gateway/Science execution, binding/finalize, and the existing compensation funnel
the cold source is a child module and can consume only the explicit typed branch inputs passed after entry classification
checkpoint count and order, complete-record CAS, locks, receipts, DTOs, visible text, history semantics, and compensation behavior remain unchanged
existing Rust AST and Python source-boundary tests now verify entry-before-cold ordering and the unchanged cold transaction funnel
durable stepwise compensation, sibling stop callers, read-model/boot sequencing, Science provenance, artifact, installed, live provider/Science, signing, and release behavior remain excluded
